records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli
evidence: result:spec-guard was updated from 0.27.0 to 0.28.0 for scope user; the cached plugin is file-for-file identical to git archive v0.28.0 apart from the host's .in_use marker

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli-hook
evidence: host:claude -p --no-session-persistence --tools '' --include-hook-events --output-format stream-json ran twice with PATH=~/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin, so the hook could only use the macOS system python3 3.9.6
result:both session inits loaded spec-guard 0.28.0 from the plugin cache and UserPromptSubmit exited 0 each time
result:in a temporary consumer repository whose first module had one open todo item, the hook injected BUILDING with the correct module, count and next step
result:after that module was finished and activeModule was set to it while the second module still lacked a plan, the hook injected MODULE_DONE naming the next unfinished module beta (NEEDS_PLAN)
limit:the all-modules DONE output and the module-insert stage hint were not exercised on the host; they are covered by test-phase-guard.sh and test_module_insert.py recorded in the source evidence
